claims.claim: Default discovery sends 20 receiving and 20 change identifiers for a fresh standard account.
claims.scope: Pinned 0.2.0 wallet core; headless captures preserve discovery defaults.
claims.limits: Not yet a packaged GUI qualification; other account types and histories can differ.

claims.claim: The main core service receives the active identifier collection; auxiliary core peers do not automatically receive it.
claims.scope: Observed core routing and source at 672df8f4.
claims.limits: Main switching may disclose to further services; a connection represents interests rather than proven ownership.

claims.claim: The helper can deliver the same individual lookup to eight candidates before returning its first answer.
claims.scope: Exact upstream function executed against eight local TLS peers.
claims.limits: Not proof that all public peers receive every request; cancellation and failures can prevent delivery.

claims.claim: Startup invokes header-only helper traffic; later financial helper traffic is conditional and can be automatic.
claims.scope: Public default-core header sends observed; proof/BEEF fallback paths reviewed.
claims.limits: A block-height query is not a TXID or full wallet disclosure.
claims.next_check: Capture package startup and a confirmed valid-chain proof path.

claims.claim: Retained disclosed identifiers and known outpoints can be watched after the client permanently leaves.
claims.scope: Retained actual wallet interests matched to manufactured later transactions.
claims.limits: Later records are currently fictional, unsigned and unconfirmed; no unlimited HD-tree access is implied.
claims.next_check: Consensus-valid isolated chain and a server switch.

claims.claim: One checkout address can identify the matching saved shop-associated collection without a payment.
claims.scope: One simulated public address matched one of three actual empty-wallet captures.
claims.limits: Address must have been disclosed; watched or shared collections complicate legal ownership.
claims.next_check: Valid-chain shop with fresh receive addresses.

claims.claim: An observer of both sides can reconstruct value flows between known collections.
claims.scope: Three captured collections and manufactured later ledger; mixed inputs and unknown payers remain unattributed.
claims.limits: A collection is not a proven person, and gross receipts are not profit or necessarily sales revenue.
claims.next_check: Confirm signed payments and post-departure activity on an isolated chain.

claims.claim: Disclosure is finite; an undisclosed unrelated script does not automatically become attributable.
claims.scope: No xpub required by reviewed calls; negative and mixed-profile controls retained.
claims.limits: External evidence or heuristics may add links, which must be named separately.
claims.next_check: Extend negative controls for undisclosed addresses and overlapping watch-only collections.

claims.claim: Ordinary direct service connections expose a connecting IP and link requests within a session.
claims.scope: Default main proxy absent; captures associate controlled requests by connection.
claims.limits: The relay capture uses loopback; an IP alone is not legal identity, and proxy exits differ from origin addresses.
claims.next_check: Packaged network metadata in an isolated application directory.

claims.claim: An arbitrary main-network proxy setting does not configure the independent helper or the reviewed direct HTTP calls.
claims.scope: 0.2.0 helper independently detects local Tor; price/update use Requests directly.
claims.limits: Environment proxies and platform routing can separately affect traffic; no universal anonymity-leak measurement yet.
claims.next_check: Controlled custom-proxy and helper certificate/routing matrix.

claims.claim: Reviewed main and helper TLS contexts do not authenticate server certificates/hostnames.
claims.scope: Python source/runtime findings; public certificates separately recorded.
claims.limits: A passive carrier does not thereby decrypt TLS; active redirection and its impact need controlled testing.
claims.next_check: Certificate rejection/acceptance matrix plus controlled impersonation.

claims.claim: A signed outgoing payment, fee, change and remaining balance were reconstructed from one session.
claims.scope: Actual wallet signs against manufactured unconfirmed fixture prevouts.
claims.limits: Not consensus-valid funding, real money, confirmed history or an ElectrumR implementation.
claims.next_check: Consensus-valid signed payment and confirmation path.

claims.claim: The ordinary captured requests do not transmit mnemonic, private keys or an unlimited-derivation xpub.
claims.scope: Reviewed controlled captures and source paths.
claims.limits: Not a complete security audit of every feature or malicious-response exploit.
claims.next_check: Verify package capture without introducing recovery material into public evidence.

claims.claim: Matching public ElectrumR implementation source/build was not obtained.
claims.scope: Recorded public/authenticated discovery and official documented source URL, October 28.
claims.limits: A 404 does not prove proprietary licensing, deletion, actual retention or lack of every possible archive.
claims.next_check: Refresh discovery and prepare a source-provenance question for publisher review.

claims.claim: The shared segment has a verified B2 Net Solutions/ServerMania network relationship.
claims.scope: ARIN/RIPEstat/DNS receipts; released source and newer-master counts are versioned separately.
claims.limits: Not proof one customer, process administrator, machine or legal operator runs all services.
claims.next_check: Refresh date-sensitive records and retain historical samples.

claims.claim: Treat related-segment services as pooling observations; also consider all-provider sharing.
claims.scope: Consumer threat scenario requested for this report.
claims.limits: Not a verified claim of common ownership or actual sharing; data visibility remains role-specific.
claims.next_check: Keep assumption labels in every public summary and diagram.

claims.claim: Reviewed consumer disclosure incompletely explains the wider profiling consequences; some public technical risk awareness exists.
claims.scope: 92 English source/docs files, 18 manual receipts, six public pages and selected public discussions.
claims.limits: User comprehension was not measured; no proof of deliberate concealment or universal ignorance.
claims.next_check: Package onboarding capture and prepare a reader-comprehension protocol.

claims.claim: Observed liveness and chain currency are timestamped, bounded samples.
claims.scope: Two rounds from one vantage on October 28; 15 headers matched two references.
claims.limits: Not an uptime SLA, global outage determination, archival completeness or deployed-build attestation.
claims.next_check: Append a publication-date refresh without overwriting earlier failures.
